leo2a7dk.name: Leopard 2A7 DK
leo2a7dk.authority: Main ruled the Denmark line on 2026-10-29 (about 12:50, DECISIONS) on the owner's request the same day ("add a bunch more denmark tanks"): Leopard 2A7 DK at tier X, a photo-class first-party build with its Danish kit; no registered 3D comparison exists for this configuration. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
leo2a7dk.envelopeBasis: Width is the as-built X extent with the Barracuda cover's drapes (the published Leopard 2A7 is about 3.8 m over the skirts; r8: 4.167 to 4.030 m once the cover's cards thinned and stood lower). Length is the as-built Z extent, the 2A7's 10.97 m with the L55A1 forward. Tallest is the curved whips' tips as built. The ribbed stowage modules follow the Danish Army's transporter photograph and the cover the Latvian live-fire photograph (Wikimedia Commons); the Forsvaret fact sheet lists both ("nye opbevaringsmoduler", "mobilt sløringssystem").
